profile: XNA 4.0 full runtime superset projected to Java 17, plus the CNA extension surface

capabilities.detail: The ownership graph and canonical XACT routes are verified; no licensed authored bank corpus qualified successful authored playback.
NULL-audio no-device behavior and native routes are verified; real capture hardware and BufferReady timing are not qualified.
Java safely exposes a PARENT_OWNED transient alias; CNA ABI 0.7 lacks XNA two-buffer identity and a frame generation token.
Metadata and player control routes execute, but HEADLESS produced no decoded frame and no qualified video asset established successful decode.
Canonical empty/default platform collections execute; populated catalog, token, thumbnail, and picture-store behavior require a real supported platform.
Java enforces XNA canonical containment before JNI; qualified CNA ABI 0.7 itself accepts parent traversal and cannot yet be credited with the guarantee.
Registration, queueing, owner-thread dispatch, containment, shutdown discard, and injected delivery are verified; no real OS device transition was observed.

The selected component lifecycle uses three canonical ABI 0.7 routes. Real sign-in/Guide/network/title-update services are absent, and current CNA HEAD cannot build the C API in either networking configuration.
Value conversion, ordered decomposition, reconstruction, and culture are implemented; Java has no CLR ComponentModel designer host, context, descriptor services, or attribute filtering.

capabilities.surface: Gamer, SignedInGamer, SignedInGamerCollection, Guide, GamerProfile, GamerPrivileges, GameDefaults, GamerPresence
capabilities.detail: Every member reaches a real CNA route and CNA answers: it publishes a local signed-in roster on this runtime and implements the Guide in process. No Xbox Live service is present, so what a real sign-in, a real friends list or a real achievement award would report is not qualified. Guide.IsScreenSaverEnabled does not round-trip, because CNA accepts the request and the headless platform does not honour it.

The event members exist, accept and remove listeners, and dispatch to them. Nothing native raises them yet: their CNA subscribe routes take real callbacks, which the JNI generator refuses by design, so hand-written callback plumbing owns that work. Backlog JAVA-XNA-005. No event is fabricated.

The whole family reaches CNA's avatar routes. XNA's avatars are an Xbox 360 facility; what a real avatar description, a real animation clip or a rendered avatar looks like is not qualified on this platform.

capabilities.surface: NetworkSession, AvailableNetworkSession, NetworkGamer, LocalNetworkGamer, NetworkMachine, NetworkSessionProperties
capabilities.detail: Creation, discovery, rosters, state and properties reach CNA. Only a SystemLink search reaches real discovery in CNA, and no second machine took part in this qualification, so a real joined session is not qualified.

Managed by design: XNA's are a BinaryReader and BinaryWriter over a memory stream, so Position and Length keep exactly that meaning over one cursor. Every value type round-trips in XNA's own layout, verified in the managed tests.

Availability, the render pipeline settings, the physically based material and the ASCII post-process effect reach CNA. This build carries the extended layer, so availability reports true; a build without it answers false and the routes raise ExtensionNotSupportedException rather than downgrading. The CRT and depth-reduction effects are not bound yet: backlog JAVA-EXT-004.

The platform, desktop operating system, renderer name, backend category and maturity, application title and CNA's logger all reach CNA and are asserted against what this build reports: Desktop, Linux, HEADLESS, Diagnostic, Supported.
